# CampusNav
> Indoor Campus Navigation System for Anjuman-i-Islam's Kalsekar Technical Campus (AIKTC), New Panvel.

CampusNav provides web-based indoor navigation, classroom and laboratory lookup, and Dijkstra shortest-path routing across multi-floor campus buildings.

## Core Features
- **Interactive Floor Maps**: SVG floor plans for Engineering Building Floors 2 and 3.
- **Shortest Path Routing**: Dijkstra algorithm calculation across corridor waypoint nodes.
- **Multi-Floor Transitions**: Automatic staircase transition guidance between floors.
- **Smart Search**: Filterable lookup for classrooms, computer labs, staff rooms, washrooms, and lounges.
- **Location QR Codes**: Scannable QR links to share starting points or destinations with others.

## Pages & Links
- [Home](https://campusnav.vercel.app/): Overview, campus departments, and FAQ.
- [Interactive Map](https://campusnav.vercel.app/map): Live floor navigation and room finder.
- [About Us](https://campusnav.vercel.app/about): About the creators, tech stack, and background.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Dijkstra's Algorithm for Shortest Path Routing
- Backend: Python FastAPI
- Database: PostgreSQL via Supabase
